svg.title: Hearing loss: the Weber and Rinne together split conductive (ear canal; otitis media; a fixed or broken middle ear) from sensorineural (sudden, an emergency; gradual and symmetric; one-sided and progressive, a vestibular schwannoma until proven otherwise; other causes: congenital, a transverse temporal bone fracture and more); a tier under each group traces the sound path it affects; each column gives presentation, investigations and treatment, and otitis media lists its complications
